svg.title: Versioning without version fields: generations on one port
svg.desc: Three phases: one generation; a frozen generation beside a free one on the same port, guarded by CI; the next generation, with the oldest retired by deletion.

g.text: Versioning without version fields: generations on one port
2 - a new generation beside the frozen one
3 - the next generation; the oldest retired
The port is multiplexed from day one
fail if VehicleLegacy in update or removed
No version field in any pack · no switch(version) in any handler · one byte per socket, never per pack
